verdict.rationale: Docusign offers a REST API and Node.js client that can send, sign, and manage agreements end-to-end (docusign-docs-21, docusign-docs-13/38, docusign-gh-1/3), and a documented MCP connector for Claude that can retrieve agreement context, query status, and trigger workflow actions (docusign-docs-36/37, docusign-probe-3). However, the AI drafting capability (flagging clauses, generating language) lives in the separate CLM/AI-Assisted Review product and MS Word plugin, not shown as callable through the same API/MCP flow used for sending/signing, so a single agent-driven 'draft NDA + route for signature' pipeline via API or MCP is not directly evidenced. Missing for 10: a concrete example or docs showing AI-generated NDA content being fed into the same API/MCP call that creates the envelope and routes it for signature, and independent confirmation that the MCP server supports document creation/drafting rather than just status/context retrieval.
